finalYaml:
trigger:
  branches:
    include: [main]
variables:
  - group: payments-common
  - name: dbPassword
    value: abcdefg123
  - name: Config
    value: Release
stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: build
        pool: {vmImage: ubuntu-latest}
        steps:
          - task: SonarQubePrepare@5
            inputs: {SonarQube: sonar, projectKey: k}
          - task: DotNetCoreCLI@2
            displayName: Test
            inputs: {command: test}
            continueOnError: true
          - task: SonarQubeAnalyze@5
          - task: SonarQubePublish@5
          - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
            inputs: {targetPath: out, artifact: drop}
  - stage: Dev
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - deployment: deploy_dev
        environment: orders-dev
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureFunctionApp@2
                  inputs: {azureSubscription: conn-dev, appType: functionAppLinux, appName: orders-dev, package: out/*.zip}
  - stage: Prod
    dependsOn: Dev
    jobs:
      - deployment: deploy_prod
        environment: orders-prod
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureFunctionApp@2
                  inputs: {azureSubscription: conn-prod, appType: functionAppLinux, appName: orders-prod, deployToSlotOrASE: true, slotName: staging}
                - script: curl -f https://orders-prod/health
                  displayName: Smoke test
